releases.name: Goat Simulator 3: Ticket to Dizzyworld
releases.summary:
Welcome to Dizzyworld. An immersive goat-themed baa-musement park, letting you reach higher ups and downs than your mood swings. 

Did you manage to save the Multiverse AND survive the apocalypse?

Take a well-deserved break and feel the g(oat)-force on the many thrilling rides the park has to offer, turn innocent visitors into baalloons, watch them puke, and trade Dizzy Tokens for sweet rewards. 

Sounds like vacation to me. 

Secure your ticket today, enjoy the dizziness later. 

Dizzyworld – where magic sometimes happens
KEY FEATURES:

    Experience all rides from a first-goat perspective

    Use a scooter to rest your tired hooves, or get into a bumper car for a free whiplash

    Cotton candy. If this isn’t a selling point, I don’t know what is

    Visitors and staff have been added for that real-life amusement park feeling

    New goats, gears, achievements, and map to meh around with

    Switch your emotional roller coaster for a real one. Or at least an in-game one

    A jam-packed playground with lots to explore

    Sandbox gameplay à la OG Goat Simulator

releases.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance + Online
releases.summary:
For the first time ever on console, descend together. The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ brings the complete game to console with full online cooperative play for up to four players. Every character, every item, every path, every ending, now with friends online.

Key Features

    Full online cooperative play for up to four players, on console.
    The complete game: The Binding of Isaac: Rebirth plus all downloadable content (“Afterbirth,” “Afterbirth+,” “Repentance,” and “Repentance+”).
    Hundreds of items, dozens of characters and endlessly randomized runs.
    Rebalanced items and improvements from years of updates.

releases.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
releases.summary: Vice City, USA. Jason and Lucia have always known the deck is stacked against them. But when an easy score goes wrong, they find themselves on the darkest side of the sunniest place in America, in the middle of a criminal conspiracy stretching across the state of Leonida – forced to rely on each other more than ever if they want to make it out alive. [GTA VI]

releases.name: Seicross
releases.summary: Danger zones, suicide bikers, explosions, and booby traps-all stand in your way as you race your super space bike into the enemy city to rescue the captured people of Petras. Then you must destroy the Dinosaur Tank that is aimed straight at you. But, watch out! Your Energy Pack needs to be replaced to keep your bike energized and your laser beam strong.

releases.name: My Life: Safari Vet
releases.summary: A lion cub needs your help – quick! Grab your vet bag and set off on a wild safari adventure! Examine animals, nurse them back to health, and discover Africa’s amazing wildlife. On foot or in your jeep, your next exciting animal rescue is just around the corner!

releases.name: The Firemen 2: Pete & Danny
releases.summary: Ever wanted to be hero? Here's your chance in this solid sequel to the art of firefighting. Pete and Danny are comrades in arms, ready to help trapped victims out of terrifying fires. The action is set in the center of a burning theme park. You'll be briefed on your mission and off you go. Two types of hose are at your disposal: a wide spray and a power jet. Play in two-player mode for super-hot action!

releases.name: Darkness and Flame: The Dark Side
releases.summary:
Alice and her companions just blew up a dam and buried the army of the Darkness under thousands of tons of water. Victory was practically guaranteed. But the Dark Warrior survived, and created a hurricane so powerful that it nearly killed them all! Alice regains consciousness on the Dark Side of the Great Fissure, a place where nobody has been for decades. To make matters worse, the power of the burning flame has started to fade.

Travel with Alice through dark lands and deserted settlements into the heart of the Dark Side. Are you ready for a difficult, but thrilling journey? Find out in this wonderful Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure!

releases.name: The House of Tesla: Definitive Edition
Savoury Cascade
releases.summary:
Savoury Cascade is a Match-3 puzzle game that combines cooking, challenges, and managing a small café in a cozy experience.

Inherit an old café and your grandmother’s recipe book. Complete 81 levels across 9 chapters at Culinary School, unlock new recipes, and get ready to run your own establishment.

In Story Mode, take on a 16-day season, prepare dishes, serve customers, earn tips, and invest in upgrades for your kitchen. Each day brings new challenges, orders, and opportunities.

Discover 88 dishes, 44 ingredients, and 51 kitchen items. Match ingredients, create special powers, and overcome different obstacles across three difficulty levels.

After completing the campaign, keep sharpening your skills in Endless Mode and aim for new high scores.

releases.name: Dark Rail
releases.summary: Turn-based management roguelike. Command the Inquisition and rule an industrial city on the empire’s edge. Use your train to meet prisoner shipment quotas by hunting heretics and slaying magical beasts. Produce supplies, contain revolt, and sacrifice prisoners to stop the madness.

releases.name: Darkness and Flame: Missing Memories
releases.summary: Your uncle Colin is haunted by nightmares of a familiar woman begging him for help. Convinced that he will find answers if only he can remember, he calls on you for help. Now you must set out on a dangerous adventure to find a healer who can restore your uncle's lost memories. But you must hurry - the Darkness is hunting you! Together, you will need to face many trials, solve dozens of puzzles, and ultimately face the dark army threatening the whole world! Will you succeed in time?

releases.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
releases.summary:
Get ready to dive into an entirely new adventure as you become a magical Merfolk and embark on a sweeping journey across the sea to reach a faraway kingdom, where strange echoes of its past await. Along the way, you’ll meet some unforgettable new friends, including Milo Thatch, Captain Jack Sparrow, and Megara, as you uncover the mysteries waiting beyond the waves.

The Keepsake Sea will introduce brand-new Biomes to explore, mysterious underwater areas to uncover, and new spaces to fully customize. From exploring what lies beneath the surface to discovering the secrets of this faraway kingdom, there’s plenty of adventure waiting for you!

releases.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
releases.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the se-ries. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.

releases.name: Soul Reaver 2
releases.summary: Raziel returns to various eras of Nosgoth's dark past in his relentless pursuit of Kain. Encounter new enemies as you unearth the mysteries of Nosgoth's ancient races, and expose the schemes behind the corruption of the Pillars, and the vampire genocide. [Eidos Interactive]

releases.name: Tidy Up: Electronic Store Simulator
releases.summary: Bring order to a chaotic electronics store! Pick up misplaced gadgets, find where every item belongs, organize shelves and displays, earn rewards, upgrade your abilities, and transform a messy store into a perfectly organized space.

releases.name: POPUCOM
releases.summary: Venture together with your friends on an unknown planet. Use color switching, match-3 shooting, and artifact powers to overcome challenges and keep advancing. What lies ahead of you is an adventure filled with wonder, hope, and much more to discover!

releases.name: Duck Side of the Moon
releases.summary: Waddle and fly as a duck in space! Explore every corner of the galaxy and find curious creatures and materials along the way. Craft gadgets, upgrade your spaceship, and get cozy in this relaxing adventure.

releases.name: Moonlight Peaks
releases.summary: Welcome to your new vampiric life in the magical town of Moonlight Peaks. Raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the local werewolves, witches, and mermaids in this heartwarming supernatural life-sim. Eternity awaits!

releases.name: Ranger's Path: National Park Simulator
releases.summary:
In Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator, you take on the everyday responsibilities of a real park ranger in the stunning Faremont National Park. Restore and maintain scenic trails, assist visitors, and document wildlife in a living, breathing ecosystem.

You’ll clear blocked paths, collect litter, fix broken signs - and occasionally drop everything to respond to urgent wildlife sightings or missing hikers. Each day brings new tasks and surprises.

Faremont’s diverse biomes range from dense forests and meadows to winding rivers. With your ranger pickup, you’ll cover long distances along the park’s road network, reaching remote areas filled with natural landmarks like waterfalls, rock formations, and scenic viewpoints.

As you explore, use your camera to observe animal behavior and expand your personal wildlife lexicon. From elusive wolves and majestic eagles to mischievous raccoons, each species adds life to the park’s biological habitat.

releases.name: DONGDA Gangster
releases.summary:
About This Game
Immersed in the turbulent "Tohoku" underworld epicof the 1980s, "Northeast Past" is a real-life interactivevideo game that combines hardcore underworldsurvival rules with multi-branching narratives, takingyou to experience the underworld and get involved inthe bloody fate of gang disputes.

A Star-Studded Team for an Authentic Adaptation
Directed by Kong Ergou, the original author of the novel, the game stays true to the core of the beloved storyline. Di Huangjin, a renowned interactive movie game producer, oversees the entire gameplay experience from concept to release. The original star cast of the IP also returns for this adaptation. While preserving the IP’s iconic essence, we’ve crafted a fresh take on the story, delivering cinematic live-action interactive gameplay that captures the unadulterated spirit of the Northeast underworld and a one-of-a-kind brand of Eastern heroic fervor.

An Iconic IP – Live the Underworld Legend Yourself
The original novel has sold over 40 million copies, and its live-action adaptation is a Douban classic with an 8.8/10 rating! This time, you’re no longer a bystander to the legend—you forge and write your own 20 years of fiery heroism. Step into the Northeast underworld of the 80s and 90s, and make pivotal choices that could either ignite a blazing legacy or lead to total ruin, amid the fire and frost of a transformative era.

Your Choices Shape the Underworld
Play as Zhao Hongbing and navigate the twists and turns of a life of chaos and courage, making choices that split the story into distinct paths at every turn. Stand by your brothers through thick and thin without hesitation, or swallow your pride and endure humiliation just to survive—every decision unlocks a radically different story branch. Will you become a legendary underworld lord? Or will your fiery life burn out too soon, a tragic ballad cut short? Unlock a host of epic, high-stakes endings as you carve your path.

Immersive Era, Meticulous Detail
With top-tier artistic craftsmanship, the game recreates an era where passion and courage ran through every street. From rusted old factory districts to neon-drenched nightclubs, every scene is steeped in the raw, unfiltered energy of 1980s and 90s Northeast China.

Dynamic Relationships, a Vivid Cast of Characters
Every encounter with the classic characters from the live-action series is a collision of fates, forging unbreakable bonds of brotherhood and heroism. The game’s Archive System delves deep into every character’s backstory, breathing life and humanity into them. Uncover hidden character arcs rife with loyalty, betrayal, and unspoken friendship—each one a new layer to the underworld’s rich tapestry.

releases.name: The Canon Keeper
releases.summary:
In The Canon Keeper, the government has destroyed nearly every Bible and replaced Scripture with its own altered version. Fragments of the original Word are still being smuggled through the resistance, and they are brought to your desk so you can determine what is real and what has been changed.

Some fragments are authentic. Some are completely fabricated. Others have only one word changed, but that one word can corrupt the entire meaning of the passage.

Examine Scripture fragments, compare wording, check references, and use the materials available to decide whether each passage should be approved or rejected. The further you get, the harder it becomes to recognize the truth, because the most dangerous lies are the ones that sound almost completely biblical.

releases.name: Cat Simulator
releases.summary:
A cat has never caused this much mischief on a farm.

Ever imagined spending hours of fun in a charming and chaotic cat simulator?

Now’s your chance! Choose your favourite feline and explore the entire farm, causing playful havoc, completing tasks, and discovering all the delightful trouble only a cat can get into.

releases.name: Reef Defense
releases.summary:
Reef Defense is a fast-paced, intense strategy game where relentless waves of crustaceans are coming for your precious eggs! Arm your reef with strategically positioned defenses and hold the line.

Can you outlast the swarm, or will your eggs become crab food?

releases.name: Leaf Blower Co.
releases.summary:
Blow your leaves and your cares away in this chilled out work sim. Build up your business, buy new tools, and unlock upgrades - all while watching the leaves fly. After all, one man’s trash is another man’s cash.

Play through the full story of Leaf Blower Co., clear away clutter and bring back a world of peace and tranquillity. And of course, no-one expects you to do all of this for free! Spend your hard-earned cash on new gear, upgrades, and even new styles. It’s important to have the right tool for the job, and if you don’t do it, who else is gonna skin your bin?

releases.name: DERELIKT
releases.summary:
Inspired by the mood and structure of System Shock 2, Alien Resurrection, Doom 3, and, DERELIKT leans into the dread of being under-equipped, out of your depth, and very far from help.

Von Neumann Outpost is a remote research station built into a derelict asteroid in Saturn’s orbit. Now its halls are dark, its systems are failing, and the few survivors left inside aren't telling the same story.

Explore the outpost’s secrets, its corridors, labs, maintenance shafts, and crew quarters. And venture deeper into stranger places inside the rock. Search for supplies, solve environmental puzzles, and unlock new routes through a station that grows more dangerous the deeper you go.

releases.name: I Am Security
releases.summary:
Step into the shoes of a club security guard in "I Am Security," where your job is to keep the club safe and ensure only the right guests get inside. 

As a security guard, you’ll face a variety of challenges that will test your observation and decision-making skills.

releases.name: Mr Sticky's Ragdoll Launch
releases.summary:
Swing, launch and survive!

Help Mr. Sticky make his way through challenging physics-based levels filled with ropes, moving platforms, lasers, traps and deadly obstacles. Use the environment and your timing to swing, bounce and launch Mr. Sticky towards the finish.

Every level brings a new challenge, with clever obstacles and physics-based mechanics that will test your timing and precision. Keep an eye on the timer and try to complete each level as quickly as possible without losing control.

Collect all the stars and beat the clock to earn a 3-star rating! Can you conquer every level, set your fastest times and become a true ragdoll master?


Features:
* 32 levels
* Fun physics ragdoll mechanics
* Different traps to avoid
* Collect all 5 stars
* Easy to play hard to master

releases.name: Draw It, Human!
releases.summary:
Pick up a pen. What you draw becomes real.

In Draw It, Human! you sketch on a magic board in virtual reality, and your robot companion turns every drawing into a living 3D object right beside you. Draw a cow and watch a UFO beam it up. Draw a T-Rex and feel the ground shake as it walks up to you.

Travel from a bright art studio to a misty dinosaur jungle, a deep ocean full of life, frozen snowfields, and the rings of Saturn. Each world asks for new drawings and rewards you with a moment you will never forget.

No drawing skills needed. If you can imagine it, you can draw it.

releases.name: Story Time
releases.summary: Three hungry goats and a grumpy troll. Three little pigs and a huffing, puffing wolf. And one curious girl who follows a golden butterfly to the three bears' cabin.Story Time is one cosy game of classic fairy tales, each performed as a cinematic show by hand-painted cardboard puppets in a toy theatre, read aloud to your child, with learning games and phonics after the show.THREE STORIES TO STARTThree Goats Gruff, Three Little Pigs, and Goldilocks and the Three Bears, with an original twist: a golden butterfly leads Goldilocks to the cabin, and the next day she comes back to say sorry and mend Baby Bear's chair.HELP TELL THE STORYEvery story is fully narrated, with voices for every character. Words light up as they are read, and any word can be tapped to hear it again. Your child taps to help tell the tale: help the goats across the bridge, help the wolf huff and puff, and help Goldilocks try the porridge, the chairs and the beds. And look out for the hidden friend on every page.A COSY PLAYROOMThe menu is a little playroom to explore: a bookshelf of storybooks, a toy chest of learning games, a homework desk for phonics, and a trophy cabinet.LEARNING GAMESEvery story has its own memory match, story quiz, put the story in order, big and small, and word games, plus a build game: Build a Troll, Build a House and Make the Porridge. Every game has Easy, Medium and Hard levels.PHONICSAll 46 sounds of English phonics, in teaching order. Tap a sound to hear it, practise sounding out and building words from the stories, and watch the word collection fill in.STICKERS AND TROPHIESEvery story has its own Sticker Book to fill, and there are trophies to win along the way.FOR EVERY READERAn easy-read font, bigger text and buttons, high-contrast text, calmer motion, and every instruction read aloud.MORE STORIES TO COMEMore stories are on the way, including the Christmas stories The Night Before Christmas and The Elves and the Shoemaker, as add-on stories.No ads. The base game has no in-game purchases; extra stories are sold separately as add-ons.

releases.name: MOTHERGUNSHIP: FORGE
releases.summary: Craft. Shoot. Die. Repeat. Forge absurdly powerful guns and fight through the belly of a metal alien monstrosity in this VR FPS roguelite follow up to MOTHERGUNSHIP. Wanna build a rocket-firing-shotgun or a toxic spike-ball-launcher? Unleash your inner mad scientist, then take on the MOTHERGUNSHIP.

releases.name: Empires Shall Fall
releases.summary:
The Great War is being waged between the Black Empire and the Blue League. For a long time, these two superpowers have struggled for domination. Take control of either faction in this turn-based tactics game and launch attacks to crush the opposition!

Empires Shall Fall is a turn-based tactics game set in a dieselpunk world. Upgrade your army and command your troops, then exploit terrain to eradicate your enemies with sheer power and sharp tactics.

Inspired by classics, Empires Shall Fall uses a grid-based map with easy-to-learn controls. Use the terrain to your advantage by strategically moving units across the board. 

Choose your position - will you join the aggressive, war-waging Black Empire, or support the Blue League's holy conquest?

releases.name: BOMBANANA!
releases.summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

releases.name: QUTAS67 - Qubic Ultimate Tap Adventure Simulator 2067
releases.summary: QUTAS 67 is a clicker game set in the year 2067, where players build a criminal empire by clicking and hiring managers to rob increasingly larger buildings with the ultimate goal of finally "releasing" the iconic, endlessly delayed game. 6️⃣7️⃣

releases.name: House Cleaner Simulator (TESTAGAMERCREATIONS)
releases.summary:
Welcome to House Cleaner Simulator - the ultimate cleaning simulator where you turn dirt into dollars!

Start small, but dream big. In House Cleaner Simulator, you’ll take on cleaning jobs in homes, offices, workshops, restaurants, and even luxurious mansions. With every sparkling surface, you grow your cleaning business and build your reputation.

Whether you’re scrubbing floors or blasting away grime, every job brings you closer to becoming the ultimate cleaning tycoon. House Cleaner Simulator is more than just a game - it’s a full-blown cleaning business simulator with satisfying gameplay and endless progression.

Grab your mop and start your journey to the top!

releases.name: Sweet Sugar Candy
releases.summary: Explore a beautiful world full of candy. Develop your skills in an hundred of well-designed levels, while collecting and using power-ups wisely. Match and crush three or more of the same candies to complete levels, using special candies where possible! You'll find more fun in this game than in any other Match game. Collect virtual currency throughout the levels (no extra purchase required, you play to win) and try your luck at the Wheel of Fortune.

releases.name: Ski Jumping World Cup
releases.summary:
Ski Jumping World Cup takes players to the world’s most iconic ski jumping hills, offering competition in both single player modes and online matches against opponents from around the globe. Feel the adrenaline of ski jumping as you compete on 18 varied hills, take part in World Cup, or create your own tournament tailored to your preferences.


Push yourself in competitive tournaments, sharpen your technique in practice mode, or challenge players worldwide in thrilling online duels.

Precision. Nerves. Flight.

releases.name: Autobahn Police Simulator 4
releases.summary:
Join the German police on the Autobahn and keep the roads safe in a fully drivable open world: unrestricted highways, winding country roads and lively towns. In Autobahn Police Simulator 4 you'll experience police duty in more depth than ever before. Conduct traffic stops, secure accident scenes and give chase when a suspect makes a run for it.

Patrol a fully drivable open world in a range of police vehicles, from the standard patrol car to an unmarked unit. Highways with rest stops and gas stations meet industrial zones, residential neighborhoods and small towns nestled between forests and mountains.

The radio calls, and you decide how to respond. Whether it's a routine stop, accident assistance or a high-speed pursuit with lights and sirens: every call brings new challenges. Act by the book and succeed on duty to earn reputation, climb the ranks and unlock new vehicles, equipment and police stations.

releases.name: Sonic Pico Park
releases.summary:
The latest entry in the PICO PARK series is a collaboration with SEGA's Sonic the Hedgehog!

Sonic the Hedgehog, celebrating its 35th anniversary this year, joins the latest entry in the PICO PARK series, a series that has sold over 8 million copies worldwide.

PICO CAT, the iconic character of the PICO PARK series, races through the world of PICO PARK with Sonic, the world’s fastest hedgehog, and his friends, including Tails, Knuckles, and Amy.

releases.name: Final Kick Football Legends
releases.summary: Final Kick Football Legends is a Sports game, developed by Ivanovich Games and published by GS2 Games.

releases.name: Hazard Levels
releases.summary:
The deeper the rift, the stranger it gets. Just make it back before last orders.

Hazard Levels is a brand new co-op survival horror from the team behind Sker Ritual.

releases.name: Cats with Guns
releases.summary:
Cats with Guns is a 2D casual game with rogue-lite elements, where you can make strategic decisions on the middle of the battle and go from a small kitten to a powerful and intimidating feline. Evolve your cat and overwhelm the enemy forces with powerful abilities. Fight sheer enemy numbers with a huge firepower and defeat the generals until you reach Meowstopia.

The game is set in the outskirts of Meowstopia, where cats once lived happily until it was invaded by rats, forcing them to flee. Now, a determined group of cats, known as The Nine Lives Brigade, is fighting to reclaim their city from the rat hordes. 

The game's premise revolves around the cats battling through waves of enemies to eventually face the leader of the rat invasion.

releases.name: Deadly Stakes
releases.summary: Deadly Stakes is a dark first-person roguelite where gambling mechanics have become part of a deadly medical experiment.You are a patient in a locked psychiatric hospital. To obtain discharge approval, you will have to endure one procedure after another: play bizarre gaming machines, pay off an ever-growing debt, and survive.The rules are simple: play, win, and pay your debt on time.Sounds easy.Until you notice the spikes on the ceiling.Every run starts off feeling fair. Spin the slot machine, roll the dice, collect pills, and gradually turn the gaming machines into a system that works for you. Buy strange medical boosters, change the odds, increase payouts, trigger repeated activations, and link effects into chains capable of tearing the game’s balance to pieces.Luck here is only the starting point.The longer you play, the stronger your build becomes - but your debt grows with it.Deadly Stakes features:- Two different types of gaming machines - a slot machine and a dice game - each with its own rules and set of upgrades.- Roguelite runs where the risk grows alongside your power.- A wide variety of combinations and synergies to create truly broken builds.- Experimental abilities that can be obtained repeatedly and strengthened.- Two interconnected resources: money to survive, pills to grow stronger.- Multiple rooms united by a single economy and one shared goal.- The suffocating atmosphere of an old psychiatric hospital, medical bureaucracy, and forced procedures.Deadly Stakes is not a gambling game.The jackpot will not make you rich.It will only buy you a little more time.

releases.name: Weed Supermarket Simulator
releases.summary: Weed Supermarket Simulator is a chill store sim where you grow weed, develop new strains, set prices, and keep your shelves stocked. Expand your business and optimize it for maximum profit. Manage employees, handle inventory, and turn your shop into a high-performing business.

releases.name: Nefiriya and the Sands of Eternity
releases.summary:
Nefiriya has just awakened from her 3,000-year slumber. Help her find a way out of the pyramid and begin a new life in the contemporary world! But beware - her destiny is in your hands. Collect gemstones along the way so she can live a wealthy and luxurious life.

Nefiriya and the Sands of Eternity is a 2D puzzle platformer where you must use Nefiriya's psychic powers to solve puzzles, such as levitating blocks or reactivating ancient mechanisms, while avoiding traps and dangers. 

Play through 25 levels to reach the pyramid's exit, but be careful - there are two different endings, and Nefiriya's future depends on how you play each level.

releases.name: Bulb Boy Anthology
releases.summary:
Enter the wonderfully weird world of Bulb Boy with both acclaimed horror adventures collected together for the first time in Bulb Boy Anthology.

Meet Bulb Boy. A small, glowing hero with a detachable head, a bizarre family and an unfortunate habit of finding himself surrounded by monsters.

In the original Bulb Boy, a terrible darkness has consumed the Bulbhouse. Bulb Boy awakens from a nightmare to discover his family missing and his home overrun by grotesque creatures. Explore the house, solve strange puzzles, uncover disturbing secrets and use Bulb Boy’s unusual abilities to bring the light back.

Then continue the story in Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair. The nightmare may be over, but when Grandparaffine sends Bulb Boy into the basement in search of a precious jar of jam, an innocent errand quickly becomes another descent into madness. Expect sticky jelly monsters, twisted puzzles, disgusting surprises and a terrifying creature with a particular interest in Bulb Boy’s head.

Blending classic point-and-click adventure, puzzle solving and horror with surreal comedy and an unmistakable cartoon style, the Bulb Boy Anthology is strange, funny, disgusting, charming and occasionally horrifying.

TWO COMPLETE ADVENTURES
Experience Bulb Boy and Bulb Boy 2: Jar of Despair together in one collection and follow Bulb Boy’s story from the darkness of the Bulbhouse to the grotesque depths beneath it.

BEAUTIFULLY GROTESQUE
A distinctive visual world inspired by classic animation and 1990s cartoons, filled with expressive characters, bizarre monsters, surreal environments and lovingly disgusting details.

USE YOUR HEAD. LITERALLY.
Bulb Boy isn't an ordinary hero. His glowing bulb head can illuminate the darkness, survive electrical shocks and even be unscrewed from his body when solving some of the games' stranger problems.

PUZZLES, MONSTERS AND SECRETS
Explore unusual environments, solve intuitive puzzles, confront horrible creatures and uncover the secrets hidden throughout Bulb Boy's world.

A STORY WITHOUT WORDS
Animated expressions, visual storytelling and Bulb Boy's distinctive bubble speech bring his strange world to life without relying on conventional dialogue.

releases.name: Repentant
releases.summary: The game is a dramatic point & click adventure about a criminal who is trying to atone for the sins of his past.

releases.name: Little Kite
releases.summary: The game about one tragic evening in an unsuccessful family, when emotions and tensions are simply too high to manage.

releases.name: The Safe Place
releases.summary: This is a dramatic deep social point&click adventure about tough childhood and self-sacrifice.
